subject: Signature trajectory: MAP, legal checkpoints, and order-form timeline
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Alan Smith <alan.smith@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Signature trajectory: MAP, legal checkpoints, and order-form timeline

Alan —

Following our demo last week, attached is a draft mutual action plan (MAP) and a short SLA summary that lays out the gating steps from eval to signature. Key asks:

- Can procurement confirm whether you need a PO before signature or are you able to sign the order form and raise a PO afterward?
- Is SOC 2 Type II evidence required for legal to clear the DPA? If yes, we can surface the report link and additional artifacts.

Proposed high-level timeline (adjustable):
- 2026-05-05: Legal review / questions (HelioHealth)
- 2026-05-06: Redwood to respond to redlines and provide SOC2 + encryption notes
- 2026-05-10: Final redline pass (if minor); otherwise escalate to exec approval
- 2026-05-13: Target signature (MSA + DPA + order form)

I've attached: MAP_Helio_20260504.xlsx (action owners, acceptance criteria, sticky dates) and Redwood_SLA_summary.pdf.

If that cadence looks reasonable, can we lock a 30-minute legal sync tomorrow (May 5) at 10:00 PT? If procurement needs more runway, please suggest alternate dates.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_Helio_20260504.xlsx (spreadsheet), Redwood_SLA_summary.pdf (summary PDF)

From: Alan Smith <alan.smith@heliohealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@heliohealth.com
Date: 2026-05-04T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Signature trajectory: MAP, legal checkpoints, and order-form timeline

Thanks Markus — this helps. A few clarifications from procurement/legal: 

1) SOC 2 Type II is required for our security team to clear the DPA. Can you provide either the full report or a secure read-only link and evidence of last audit date.
2) On the DPA, our counsel will request a limited-data-subprocessor clause and a standard breach-notification SLA (72 hours). Expect a few line edits.
3) Regarding PO: our standard is to issue a PO after signature but before provisioning (we need internal approvals). Realistically procurement is looking at May 20 for PO issuance if we sign mid-May — there are internal billing cycles to consider.

If you can provide SOC2 evidence and a quick DPA redline response by May 6 I think we can keep momentum. Happy to do the legal sync on May 5 at 10:00 PT; I'll invite our counsel and procurement owner.

Best,
Alan
Director, Vendor Programs
HelioHealth

Subject: Re: Signature trajectory: MAP, legal checkpoints, and order-form timeline

Alan —

Thanks for the quick reply and the procurement heads-up. Short answers and next steps: 

- SOC2: here is a secure viewer link: https://redwood-secure.com/reports/soc2/2025-ty2 (access: read-only). I'll also attach a short SOC2 evidence checklist to the MAP.
- DPA redlines: we expect a small set of clause edits (sub-processors + breach window). I'll ask Legal to prepare a clean redline and a suggested compromise on notification timings.
- PO cadence: understood on the May 20 PO target. To keep the customer experience smooth I propose we:
  * Lock to sign the MSA/DPA/order form on 2026-05-13,
  * Allow provisioning to wait until the PO is issued (procurement target May 20) but start technical onboarding immediately after signature if Helio gives okay.

I've revised the MAP (attached as MAP_Helio_20260504_v2.xlsx) to reflect these owners and dates. If you're comfortable I will: 
- Schedule the legal sync tomorrow May 5 at 10:00 PT and invite Redwood Legal (Neha) and our solutions lead (Laura),
- Ask our legal team to prepare a redline before the meeting so we can triage quickly.

Please confirm the meeting and whether procurement needs any additional procurement-specific fields on the order form (e.g., billing contact, PO number field timing).

Thanks —
Markus

Attachments: MAP_Helio_20260504_v2.xlsx

Neha —

Forwarding HelioHealth thread. Short ask from my side: can your team run a fast pass on the DPA redline (sub-processor + breach-notify window) and confirm whether the standard Redwood compromise below is acceptable? Procurement timeline is tight; they expect PO issuance ~May 20 but want signature earlier.

Redwood suggested compromise (for context):
- Breach notification: 72 hours for initial notification, 30 days for full report (we can expand if they need).
- Sub-processor transparency: list + 30-day notice for new sub-processors, carve-outs allowed for cloud infra providers.

Can you prioritize a redline and short note by EOD May 7 so we can present on the May 8 exec sync if needed? Attaching the latest MAP and SLA summary.

Thanks —
Markus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
